# [EPIC] Test Coverage Implementation Programme

## OPSX Parent Spec

- Parent issue: [#932](https://github.com/lightspeedwp/.github/issues/932)
- Scope: restore reliable test coverage, document the baseline, and drive the six-phase coverage programme to completion.
- Required children:
  - [#933](https://github.com/lightspeedwp/.github/issues/933) Baseline measurement and coverage gap report
  - [#934](https://github.com/lightspeedwp/.github/issues/934) Metrics agent coverage
  - [#935](https://github.com/lightspeedwp/.github/issues/935) Linting agent coverage
  - [#936](https://github.com/lightspeedwp/.github/issues/936) Release agent coverage hardening
  - [#937](https://github.com/lightspeedwp/.github/issues/937) Utility edge-case coverage
  - [#938](https://github.com/lightspeedwp/.github/issues/938) Validation and reporting closeout
- Exit criteria:
  - Coverage baseline captured and reproducible
  - Phase issues complete and linked back to the parent
  - Final report and closeout checklists completed
